entities.name: Service Gap Control
entities.description: Network mechanism to control frequency of UE transitions from 5GMM-IDLE to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode using timer T3447.

entities.name: Timer T3447
entities.description: Service gap timer that restricts UE transitions from idle to connected mode when running.

entities.name: T3447 value IE
entities.description: Information element carrying the service gap time value sent from AMF to UE.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to indicate SGC support during registration.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message used by AMF to provide T3447 value to UE.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE is not connected to the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE has an active NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: SGC active condition
entities.description: Condition where network supports SGC and T3447 value is available in UE context.

entities.name: Exception request conditions
entities.description: Conditions where SGC restrictions do not apply: emergency services, high priority access, exception data reporting.

relations.description: Service Gap Control procedure utilizes timer T3447 to control UE transitions.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains T3447 value IE.
UE indicates SGC support in REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
When SGC is active, network starts timer T3447 after UE transitions to 5GMM-IDLE mode.
UE starts timer T3447 when N1 NAS signalling connection is released and UE enters 5GMM-IDLE mode.
Timer T3447 restrictions do not apply to exception requests like emergency services.
Timer T3447 continues running when UE transitions from 5GMM-IDLE to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.
